meta.scope: Classify S833/S834 measured whole-larva behavioral targets separately from unrecorded evoked neural response

records.title: Low FoxO expression in Drosophila somatosensory neurons protects dendrite growth under nutrient restriction
The Drosophila ortholog of vertebrate TRPA1 regulates thermotaxis

validation.notes: Primary eLife full text checked. Heat-probe-evoked complete rolling behavior (Methods > Behavior assay; Results > Figure 6A-E) and C4da dendrite morphology are separate endpoints. Neural response was not measured; no subjective pain measure. Curated as included_core under the automated verified_primary rule; evidence role remains method_baseline and does not establish neural response. DOI 10.7554/eLife.53351; seed S282 v1 JATS c62. Target construct corrected to protective_behavior on 2026-09-28: The measured Figure 6 target is protective whole-larva rolling behavior after a heat probe; dendrite morphology is a separate observation, and no evoked neural response is recorded.

validation.notes: The current source card contained S833 content. Identity verified against the primary PMC/PubMed record and Crossref: Rosenzweig et al., The Drosophila ortholog of vertebrate TRPA1 regulates thermotaxis, Genes & Development 19(4):419-424 (2005), DOI 10.1101/gad.1278205, PMID 15681611. Primary Results > Drosophila larvae exhibit robust thermotactic behavior and dTrpA1 is required for thermotaxis; Results > dTrpA1(RNAi) larvae are selectively defective for thermotactic behavior; Figures 3B-C and 4H; Materials and Methods > Molecular genetics and RNAi and Behavioral assays. Figure 3C and Figure 4H group counts already in this card remain unchanged. The approximately 55 degrees C probe result is assay- and manipulation-specific; no subjective pain, human ECAP/SCS outcome, or predictive-model performance is claimed. Target construct corrected to protective_behavior on 2026-09-28: The matrix-relevant hot-probe comparator is a larval withdrawal/curling behavior; thermotaxis is a separate behavioral endpoint, and no evoked neural response is recorded.
